purpose: Score host-enumerated valid action candidates with the model and execute the model-selected one; fresh family, no training.

interface.candidates: read, run_test, stop, plus set_constant candidates derived from the observed failure and current constants
interface.selection: model likelihood over candidate JSON strings; host executes argmin
interface.no_hidden_repair: host does not choose the selected candidate and does not remove the correct option

claims: Action-interface diagnostic only; no training, default promotion or general capability claim.
